summary: כֹּה points to something the speaker indicates as a basis for comparison. In Genesis 15:5 the stars show Abram how numerous his descendants will be.

senses.definition: Points to what the speaker has indicated to show how something is or will be.

evidence.note: The invitation to count the stars supplies the comparison for כֹּה יִהְיֶה זַרְעֶךָ, “So numerous will your offspring be.”
